evidence_quality_audit: Every claimed pass must have immutable start evidence and durable close evidence.
Scheduler state should be captured from the update return, not assumed from requested parameters.
Probe IDs should encode target and start to avoid evidence mixing.
State/current is a summary pointer and must not substitute for immutable probe evidence.
Retrospective wake evidence should identify which prior probe it validates.
Boundary counters should not include supporting parallel-survival samples.
Under-target samples are useful for improving workload generation but must not affect the bracket.
Independent provider/tool failures need explicit evidence before exclusion from duration failure.
Ambiguous termination should remain ambiguous rather than being optimistically classified.
Operating-cap validation should be auditable from individual counted runs.
Final policy metrics should preserve raw timing fields so derived values can be recomputed.
Append-only probe directories reduce accidental rewriting of experimental history.
